title: Change of configuration regarding the use of SMS.

entities.name: SMS service not preferred over IP networks
entities.description: Configuration change where SMS service is not preferred to be invoked over IP networks or UE is unable to use SMS using IMS.

entities.name: SMS preferred over IP networks with no CS voice capability
entities.description: Configuration change where SMS service is preferred over IP networks, UE can use SMS via IMS, and UE has no CS voice capability.

entities.name: SMS preferred over IP networks with IMS PS voice only
entities.description: Configuration change where SMS service is preferred over IP networks, UE can use SMS via IMS, and voice domain preference is IMS PS voice only.

entities.name: Transit from PS mode to CS/PS mode
entities.description: Procedure to transit from PS mode 1 to CS/PS mode 1 or from PS mode 2 to CS/PS mode 2.

entities.name: Combined tracking area update with IMSI attach
entities.description: Procedure performing combined tracking area update with IMSI attach, with or without SMS only indication.

entities.name: Transit from CS/PS mode to PS mode
entities.description: Procedure to transit from CS/PS mode 1 to PS mode 1 or from CS/PS mode 2 to PS mode 2.

entities.name: Detach for non-EPS services
entities.description: Procedure to detach from non-EPS services.

entities.name: UE operating in PS mode 1 or PS mode 2
entities.description: UE operating in PS mode 1 or PS mode 2.

entities.name: UE operating in CS/PS mode 1 or CS/PS mode 2
entities.description: UE operating in CS/PS mode 1 or CS/PS mode 2.

relations.description: Configuration change to SMS not preferred over IP networks establishes transit from PS to CS/PS mode procedure.
Configuration change to SMS not preferred over IP networks establishes combined TAU with IMSI attach procedure.
Configuration change to SMS preferred over IP networks with no CS voice capability establishes transit from CS/PS to PS mode procedure.
Configuration change to SMS preferred over IP networks with no CS voice capability establishes detach for non-EPS services procedure.
Configuration change to SMS preferred over IP networks with IMS PS voice only establishes transit from CS/PS to PS mode procedure.
Configuration change to SMS preferred over IP networks with IMS PS voice only establishes detach for non-EPS services procedure.
UE operating in PS mode 1 or 2 is required for configuration change to SMS not preferred over IP networks.
UE operating in CS/PS mode 1 or 2 is required for configuration change to SMS preferred over IP networks with no CS voice capability.
UE operating in CS/PS mode 1 or 2 is required for configuration change to SMS preferred over IP networks with IMS PS voice only.
